findings.title: Public functions renamed and relocated without verifying/updating other references
findings.body: `mark_failed_threshold` (now `try_incident_threshold` in incidents.py) and `create_issue_platform_occurrence` (now `create_incident_occurrence` in incident_occurrence.py), along with `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, `HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP`, and `SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP`, were moved out of `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` into new modules and in some cases renamed. The PR only touches 4 files and does not show any update to test files or other call sites that may reference these symbols by their original module path or name (e.g. via `mock.patch('sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence', ...)` or direct imports in unit tests exercising threshold/occurrence logic). If any such references exist elsewhere in the codebase, they will now fail with ImportError/AttributeError or silently stop patching the intended code path, since the old names no longer exist in `mark_failed.py`.

findings.title: Typo carried over in get_failure_reason docstring
findings.body: The docstring for `get_failure_reason` reads "Builds a humam readible string from a list of failed check-ins." (should be "human readable"). This typo was simply relocated from the old `mark_failed.py` file into the new module; since this code is being actively reorganized, it would be a good time to fix the wording.
